title: Media
noMedia: No media for {{language}} yet. Click "+ Add media".
deleteConfirm: Do you really want to permanently delete this media? All linked chats and vocabulary assignments may be lost.
extractDescription: Lets the AI automatically detect vocabulary from this media and add it to your flashcards.
extractStarted: Extraction started in the background — new words will appear in your vocabulary list gradually.
subtitlesDescription: Subtitles (.srt, .vtt, .lrc) appear in the player. The track in the medium's language also serves as the text for summary, vocabulary and chat.
subtitleSourceHint: This text is used for summary, vocabulary and chat
subtitleReplaceHint: If there already is a track for that language, it is replaced.
ocrDescription: With an hOCR file (e.g. from Tesseract) words and sentences can be selected right on the picture. Pages are matched to the images by their file names. The recognized text also serves as the text for summary, vocabulary and chat.
ocrUploadError: Text recognition could not be uploaded
summaryDescription: Creates summary, topics, genre and difficulty from the text of this medium again. You can pick provider and model if the default doesn't work right now (for example its daily limit is reached).
summaryStarted: Running in the background, the result appears above as soon as it is done.
summaryTimeout: Nothing new so far. Long texts take a while; if nothing arrives at all, the reason is in the backend log (for example the provider's daily limit was reached).
